title: Week 1 Power Rankings
subtitle: Week 1 vibes — HQ custom board, matchup edges, and last-two-seasons form vs this week’s opponent (2024–25 Fantrax records). Games Sun 9/13.
method: HQ custom = live Fantrax W1 + injury/trade spice. Ranked on custom, matchup edge, and easier W2–W5 SOS.

rankings.customNote: Nix sold for $10 FAAB; Goff-only room
rankings.blurb: Fantrax has Pocket projecting like they didn’t just pawn Nix for a ten-spot. Goff-only life, Barton on the clearance rack, and somehow the model’s still thirsty. @ LAB — if this hits, Kellen owes the algorithm a fruit basket. Form edge: Pocket 5-9/10-4 (15-13) vs LAB 8-6/4-10 (12-16).

Kyle vs Tim is the ‘adults in the room’ game until someone starts an IDP. Doubtpfizer’s the clean favorite — Lemon on the wire, no drama, just a boring W waiting to be collected. Take it before the schedule gets spicy. Form edge: Doubtpfizer 6-8/9-5 (15-13) vs Morningside 3-11/6-8 (9-19).

Luke paid rent on Elarms-Orr ($20 FAAB) and gets Bill’s TE buffet at home. Slight favorite, which in this league means ‘please don’t let a backup LB ruin Christmas.’ Win and the room has to admit Saltese is cooking. Eddies owns the better recent card (20-8 vs 15-13). Upset szn starts now or never.

Gavin + Donald vs Jacob’s Hyper crew — coin flip with a side of pass rush. If the IDP goes nuclear, Dongers jump the mid-tier queue; if not, we’re all pretending we believed in Hyper all along. Dongers is 14-14 the last two Fantrax years; Hyper’s still unproven.

Chase rolls into Towner’s house (yes, Slumlords — not Aga, we checked twice) projecting like the road favorite. Trade chaos? $10 FAAB out? Cute. Survive Sunday and the Dongers date in W2 is where the real trauma starts. Form edge: TTAB 7-7/6-8 (13-15) vs Slumlords 4-10/2-12 (6-22).

rankings.customNote: Flat adjust; $10 FAAB bank from Nate handshake
rankings.blurb: Slight dog at Dongers with extra FAAB jingling from Nate’s R20 handshake. Hang around, don’t gift a dunk-on-able scoreboard, and let the wire do the talking later. Jacob’s a blank slate; the Sak chair went 15-13 the last two years then dipped. Dongers is 14-14 over 2024–25.

Jesse hosts Pocket’s QB reboot tour. Yesterday this looked like a smash; today Fantrax has Kellen ahead on paper. Still: home crowd, Goff fog, and a chance to make Pocket’s ‘model loves us’ narrative look silly. Pocket owns the better recent card (15-13 vs 12-16). Upset szn starts now or never.

rankings.customNote: Tight W1 now — less free than old board
rankings.blurb: Ryan M vs Heff — used to be a bye-week energy mismatch, now it’s a proper scrap on the new board. Still favored. Cash the W before W3 Saltese shows up with clipboards. Pedigree check: Goats is 20-8 over 2024–25 while Newman sits 11-17. History’s loud; Week 1 doesn’t have to listen.

rankings.customNote: Sold Elarms-Orr for FAAB — cash over W1 juice
rankings.blurb: Aga’s cash-rich, projection-thin, and visiting Nate. Sold the IDP stud for FAAB, which is either galaxy-brain or a future podcast apology. Separate slate from the Towner/Chase circus — prove the build. Form edge: Ultron 8-6/9-5 (17-11) vs Substation 7-7/7-7 (14-14).

rankings.customNote: Warren dinged; TE depth + $105 FAAB still loud
rankings.blurb: Bill’s on the road at Saltese with a dinged Warren and a TE room that still looks illegal. $105 FAAB says the wire’s not scared. Get to 1–0 and W2 Goats looks like a palate cleanser. Form edge: Eddies 8-6/12-2 (20-8) vs Saltese 8-6/7-7 (15-13).

Ryan Towner hosts Chase in the Week 1 headliner — not Ultron, not Aga, just two Towners’ worth of chaos branding. Fresh Fantrax has TTAB ahead; the home crowd disagrees. Statement game or early meme. No in-between. TTAB owns the better recent card (13-15 vs 6-22). Upset szn starts now or never.

Heff draws Newman Lake to open. Veterans’ tax is due Sunday — pay it, survive, then hunt the wire like the old bulls still remember how. Résumé flex: Goats went 20-8 the last two years; Newman is 11-17. That’s not a rivalry, that’s a LinkedIn.

rankings.customNote: Paid $10 FAAB for Nix; dropped Love
rankings.blurb: Nate dropped Love, paid Pocket $10 for Nix, and still starts the week looking like the bargain bin. Home vs Ultron is the chance to make ‘budget QB arc’ sound intentional. Dart/Nix roulette: spin responsibly. Ultron owns the better recent card (17-11 vs 14-14). Upset szn starts now or never.

Tim’s the biggest dog on the board at Doubtpfizer. Early FAAB window if the offense ghost-jobs — just don’t dig a 0–2 crater before September ends. Doubtpfizer owns the better recent card (15-13 vs 9-19). Upset szn starts now or never.
